what_worked: Billing with numbers, plus catching problems before she does. Stephski's 'we havent seen it come through on our side yet / just incase it bounced again' (10-12) and 'we recieved! it was $3189 so i rolled over the over payment' (10-15) got 'Hi babe / I'll check on it today' and 'Hi dear thank you so much xx', with no audit or pushback.

Specific, actionable updates get warm replies. Mayson's 10-11 link-in-bio update, which named the domain and told her exactly what to do, got 'Amazing !! Thank you Mayson'. Melissa's dated repost-network plan the week before got 'Amazing ❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥' (10-02). The pattern to keep: a named action, a date, and proof.

Clear role introductions are welcomed. Spencer's 'Ill be handling all customs, content uploads, and backend chat assistance' got 'Perfect thanks' within a minute. The format works, but it needs to carry over the open items.
